title: Sunlit Breeze Revival

diffuser.notes: Perfect for a midday pick-me-up; run for 30 minutes.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist around the room.

why_it_works: Lemon and peppermint deliver a crisp, cooling lift for hot days, while lavender softens the edge and adds a calming floral balance—energizing yet serene.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
